inlines.v: BLA'ZON, verb transitive bla'zn. 1. To explain, in proper terms, the figures on ensigns armorial. 2. To deck; to embellish; to adorn. She blazons in dread smiles her hideous form. 3. To display; to set to show; to celebrate by words or writing. 4. To blaze about; to make public far and wide. 5. To display; to exhibit conspicuously. There pride sits blazon'd on th' unmeaning brow. BLA'ZON, noun The art of drawing, describing or explaining coats of arms; perhaps a coat of arms, as used by the French. 1. Publication; show; celebration; pompous display, either by words or by other means.
